activity.name: Resiliency for Teens
activity.description: In this course, you will learn what it means to be resilient. First, we will define resiliency and understand its importance in our lives. Then, we'll identify and apply strategies to navigate situations where building resiliency is key. Next, we will learn practical skills to reframe negative thoughts and understand the differences between a growth and a fixed mindset. We'll also learn how resiliency can help us build positive relationships with others. Last, we will create a personalized Resiliency Toolkit with strategies learned throughout the course!  Through practical exercises, self-reflection questions, and meaningful learning, you will learn to navigate challenges, build resilience, and enhance your confidence and self-esteem.
